_comment: Copy this file to config.json (same folder as the app) and edit. Credentials are NOT here -- put the camera username in .camera_user and password in .camera_pw (plain text, one line each).
_use_proxy_help: Leave use_proxy false on a normal single-network PC. It is only a Mac dev workaround for a dual-subnet routing clash.
_ffmpeg_help: ffmpeg is required. Put ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe in a folder named 'ffmpeg' next to the app, OR on the system PATH, OR set ffmpeg_path / ffprobe_path below to full paths.
